title: oxCrap configuration
description: Options for oxCrap, in .oxcraprc.json. Paths and globs are read from the folder this file is in. See README.md beside this schema.

$schema.description: The path to this schema, so editors can check the file.

files.description: Globs of the files to score, as Node's fs.globSync takes them: `**` matches any number of folders, `*` any characters but `/`, and `{a,b}` either alternative.

ignorePatterns.description: Patterns left out of scoring, in gitignore style, as oxlint's ignorePatterns are: from this file's folder, with `name/` for a folder at any depth and `!` to bring a file back. A folder that matches isn't searched. Setting this replaces the default list.

limits.description: A function fails when its CRAP score or its complexity is over its limit.

crap.description: The highest CRAP score a function may have.

complexity.description: The highest complexity a function may have, however well it's tested.

coverage.description: The istanbul JSON coverage report, such as coverage/coverage-final.json. `--coverage` overrides it.

guide.description: A document the findings point to, such as a procedure for responding to them. `--guide` overrides it.
